  int64_t digits = 0;
  while (n) {
    ++digits;
    n /= 10;
  }
  return digits;
}

  int64_t res = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    res = 10*res + 1;
  return res;
}

  if (n == 0) return 0;
  n = n < 0 ? -n : n;
  int64_t d = nb_digits(n);
  return d + aux2(n-ones(d));
}

  if (acc >= max) return max;
  if (n == 0) return acc;
  if (n < 0) { n = -n; sign = -sign; }
  int64_t d = nb_digits(n);
  int64_t ones_d = ones(d);
  int64_t res1 = max, res2 = max;

  if (0 <= already_in[d]*sign && -10 < already_in[d] && already_in[d] < 10) {
    already_in[d] += sign;
    res1 = aux(n-ones_d, sign, acc+d, max, already_in);
    already_in[d] -= sign;

    already_in[d+1] += sign;

    already_in[d+1] -= sign;
  }
  return res1 < res2 ? res1 : res2;
}
